still_open.finding: The utilization schema defines lane-owned ledgers under governance/second-shift/execution-events/YYYY-MM-DD/{CORE|LEARNING|BOOK|PROSE}.json, but the execution-events directory is absent on current main. Historical useful-work duration therefore remains UNKNOWN rather than inferable from commits or runner uptime.

Current second-shift-enforce.js validates local delegation structure, exact-SHA syntax, claims/leases/heartbeats, overlapping claims, stale READY work, false-empty/all-rungs proof, required control files and shift event-ledger presence. It does not itself fetch the remote canonical owner ref or independently compare the delegated objective against durable owner completion/successor state before accepting the local active delegation.
